sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the ship-owned completion status together with universal crew-duty-to-PWOM-item familiarization-record coverage through both supplied ship-to-crew paths, without imposing unsupported existence constraints.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1 constraints from hasCrewMember, hasCrewMemberInventory, hasAssignedDuty, hasRelevantPolarWaterOperationalManualItem, hasFamiliarizationRecord, and familiarizationRecordItem. The universal every-crew-member coverage rule does not independently require existence of crew, duties, relevant items, or records; matching records are already required by the coverage query whenever a relevant duty item exists. Retain both supplied ship-to-crew paths and their sh:node validation so every crew member present through either relationship is checked, retain the ship-owned boolean status requirement, and revise the affected messages so they no longer claim unconditional existence.

Candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the ship-owned completion status together with universal crew-duty-to-PWOM-item familiarization-record coverage through both supplied ship-to-crew paths, without imposing unsupported existence constraints.
